sources.title: Unity ML-Agents Toolkit - GitHub
sources.snippet: The ML-Agents Toolkit is mutually beneficial for both game developers and AI researchers as it provides a central platform where advances in AI can be evaluated on Unity's rich environments and then made accessible to the wider research and game developer communities.
